# Roblox Customizer — Privacy Policy

English · [简体中文](PRIVACY.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](PRIVACY.zh-TW.md) · [Bahasa Indonesia](PRIVACY.id.md) · [日本語](PRIVACY.ja.md) · [ไทย](PRIVACY.th.md) · [한국어](PRIVACY.ko.md)

Last updated: 2026-10-20<br>
Publisher: Lunarfox 月狐

This policy explains how Roblox Customizer handles information. It covers this browser extension, not Roblox, the browser, or third-party services, which have their own policies.

[Terms of Service](TERMS.md)

## Information used by the extension

Information is used to provide the features you see in the extension:

- Preferences: language, colors, appearance, Home and social-feed settings, currency selection, language-warning state, and whether you have accepted the Terms of Service.
- Backgrounds: files you select, their names, and saved background URLs. Selecting a local file stores a browser-local copy; it does not upload the file to the publisher.
- Fonts: font files you select and their file names. A browser-local copy changes Roblox text; the file is not uploaded to the publisher.
- Organization: pinned game IDs, game names and thumbnails, folder names, and hidden recommendations.
- Playtime: Roblox user IDs and usernames, game/universe/place IDs, game names and icons, estimated durations, session counts, and first/last played and sampling timestamps for each recorded account.
- Recent servers: Roblox user IDs, game/universe/place IDs, server instance IDs, game names, and last-observed timestamps for recent-server history.
- Roblox content: page URLs and content, profile, avatar, friends, inventory, badge, game, server, and social-link information needed for page styling and tools. Existing account, message, and transaction pages may be restyled locally; their contents are not uploaded to the publisher. The extension does not read your browsing history on unrelated websites.
- Temporary or cached information: public social posts and thumbnails, exchange rates, API responses, and server-country estimates.

## Local storage and playtime

Preferences, pins, history, and some caches use the browser's extension-local storage. Background files use IndexedDB on the Roblox site origin where they were selected. Small appearance and friend-row caches use Roblox-site localStorage. The extension does not use Chrome storage sync or a publisher-operated cloud account.

Playtime tracking is enabled by default and checks the signed-in account's Roblox presence approximately every 30 seconds while the browser runs, including when Roblox tabs are closed. It estimates activity from those samples, not recordings of gameplay. Disabling playtime stops new playtime records and preserves existing history. Presence checks continue if recent-server tracking remains enabled; unsupported-language fallback pauses both features.

Recent-server tracking is enabled by default and shares the approximately 30-second presence checks with playtime. Its independent setting stops new server records while keeping saved history. Each of the 10 most recently used accounts retains a separate list of up to 6 servers per game, including that game's subplaces; a new server replaces only that game's oldest entry.

The extension does not ask for your Roblox password. Authenticated Roblox API calls use your browser's existing Roblox session, so Roblox receives the authentication associated with those requests. Backups do not include Roblox passwords or session cookies.

Selected font files also use IndexedDB on the Roblox site origin where they were selected. A small font-selection cache uses that site's localStorage; it contains settings and a file identifier, not font bytes.

## Network requests and third parties

Requests are made when the relevant feature runs. The services below receive the requested identifiers or resources and ordinary connection information, such as your network IP address and request headers. They may keep their own logs under their policies. Roblox account credentials are not sent to the non-Roblox APIs listed here.

- Roblox APIs and image services: account and user IDs, game/place/universe IDs, badge/item IDs, server IDs, and related queries to load information, thumbnails, presence, and server details. Roblox handles its own website and account activity separately.
- ipwho.is: a Roblox game server's public IP address for an estimated server country. This is a lookup of the game server, not a request to locate your device; the service still sees the connection IP used to make the request.
- Rolimons (www.rolimons.com): the requested game/place ID for public game statistics. Opening a player or server analytics link sends that destination's identifiers to Rolimons.
- FxEmbed (api.fxtwitter.com) and X image hosts (pbs.twimg.com and mosaic.fxtwitter.com): the public X handle linked on a Roblox page, plus post/image references, to display public posts and media.
- YouTube (www.youtube.com) and its image host (i.ytimg.com): public channel handles or IDs and video/image IDs to show recent videos and thumbnails. Feed requests do not send YouTube login credentials.
- jsDelivr (cdn.jsdelivr.net) and the currency API mirror (latest.currency-api.pages.dev): requests for public USD exchange-rate data. Your Roblox balance and playtime history are not sent to these rate services.
- A saved remote background URL: the background host receives a request for that file when it loads. Local background files require no such request. Links to support or other sites contact those sites only when you open them.

## Publisher access and use

The extension has no publisher-operated data collection endpoint, advertising tracker, or usage-analytics service. It does not send your local preferences, backgrounds, or playtime history to the publisher, and the publisher does not sell that data or use it for targeted advertising. Data is used for the extension's stated features.

If you voluntarily contact support or submit an issue, the publisher receives the information you send, such as your contact name, email, report, or screenshots. It is used to respond and troubleshoot, and retained only as needed for that purpose or legal obligations. You may request deletion by email, subject to those obligations and the support platform's rules. GitHub issues and public social posts can be visible to others; use email for private requests.

Browser stores may separately provide the publisher with aggregate installation statistics, reviews, and information you submit through their services. Those activities are governed by the store's policies.

## Your controls, retention, and deletion

You can change preferences, remove backgrounds and pins, disable social feeds and playtime tracking, clear the current account's playtime, and export your data. Settings backups include all recorded accounts' histories and a saved background when present. Backups are unencrypted JSON files; keep them private. Import replaces the corresponding saved data rather than merging it.

Recent-server history is excluded from full settings backups. You can delete individual servers, clear one game's list, or clear the current account's recent servers. Reset All also removes all accounts' recent-server history. Turning off only playtime does not stop server-history presence checks; disable both settings to stop those checks.

Saved preferences, files, and histories remain until you remove, reset, or overwrite them or the browser clears storage. Cached responses may remain stored after they expire for use. Reset All deletes extension-local settings, caches, pins, and all accounts' history, and removes background files and page caches on the current Roblox site origin. It keeps the local Terms of Service acceptance flag so the first-opening prompt is not repeated. Default features may resume after reset; disable tracking again if you want it off.

Uninstalling normally removes extension-local storage but may leave Roblox-site IndexedDB and localStorage. Use Reset All before uninstalling, or clear Roblox site data in your browser to remove those remaining files and caches. Site-data deletion may sign you out. If fallback mode hides data controls, first switch Roblox to English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Indonesian, Japanese, Thai, or Korean. Exported files and data stored by third parties must be deleted separately.

The publisher cannot inspect or remotely erase data stored only in your browser. Contact the publisher for questions or requests about information you sent to support.

Restore default font removes the selected font from the current site origin. Reset All also removes saved fonts there. Settings backups include a selected font file, including when temporarily disabled.

## Security, younger users, and updates

Built-in API requests use HTTPS. Local browser storage and exports have no additional encryption supplied by this extension; protect your device, browser profile, and backup files. No security method can guarantee complete protection.

The extension does not request an age, create a separate user account, or collect children's information for advertising. The same local processing described above applies to all users. Parents or guardians can help younger users manage settings and delete local data.

This policy will be updated when the extension's data practices change. The date above identifies the version. Material changes will be described in the release information and, where required, in an in-extension notice before the new processing begins.

## Contact

For questions about these documents, privacy requests, or support, contact the publisher by email. Telegram and X are also available. Please do not send passwords, session cookies, or unredacted backups.
